prs.notes: Also removes the ember-eslint-parser@0.16.0, ember-estree@0.9.0 and eslint-plugin-ember@13.8.0 entries from minimumReleaseAgeExclude.

held.name: glob
held.reason: GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4 is fixed only in glob 14, and every package that installs glob allows only glob 7 to 13, so it would need a pnpm override

held.name: minimatch
held.reason: GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 is fixed only in minimatch 11, and every package that installs minimatch allows only minimatch 3 to 10, so it would need a pnpm override

held.name: i18n
held.reason: Discourse reverted an update to 1.15 in #43363

held.name: omniauth-oauth
held.reason: lets strategies store several sign-ins in the session, which Discourse keeps in a cookie

held.name: omniauth-oauth2
held.reason: lets strategies store several sign-ins in the session, which Discourse keeps in a cookie

held.name: oauth2
held.reason: 2.1.0 blocks cross-origin redirects by default; 2.0.26 has the same security fix

held.name: capybara-playwright-driver
held.reason: fill_in types long values one key at a time, which slows down system tests; 0.5.11 is not on rubygems.org

held.name: @ember/test-helpers
held.reason: render() goes through renderComponent, and integration tests fail with NotFoundError from Glimmer (found in #45406)

held.name: prosemirror-view
held.reason: a separator image in front of inline atom nodes breaks 45 rich editor tests, whose helper needs a change by a person (found in #45406)

held.name: @embroider/*
held.reason: @embroider/vite 1.8.0 adds hashes to the virtual file names that the QUnit page loads by name, and the @embroider packages move together

held.name: @glint/*
held.reason: newer releases need typescript below 7, and Discourse uses typescript 7.1

held.name: eslint
held.reason: @discourse/lint-configs pins it

held.name: prettier
held.reason: @discourse/lint-configs pins it

held.name: stylelint
held.reason: @discourse/lint-configs pins it

held.name: oj
held.reason: 3.17.8 drops its ostruct dependency, and lib/onebox.rb requires ostruct, which Ruby 4.0 does not ship; needs gem "ostruct" in the Gemfile (found in #46453)

held.name: ember-source
held.reason: 7.4 raises its browser floor to iOS 16.6 and Safari 18.5, and frontend/discourse/config/targets.js still lists Safari 16.4 and iOS 16.4; a person must decide whether Discourse drops those

held.name: annotaterb
held.reason: 4.26.0 writes enum column defaults by name, such as default("detailed") where the plugins/boards annotations say default(0), so Check Annotations fails until a person regenerates them (found in #46452)

held.name: @babel/*
held.reason: @embroider/core and @embroider/compat depend on @babel/core ^7, and ember-cli-babel needs it as a peer

held.name: @fullcalendar/*
held.reason: the daygrid, timegrid, list, interaction, moment and moment-timezone plugins have no 7.x release and need @fullcalendar/core ~6.1.22

held.name: @uppy/*
held.reason: @uppy/aws-s3 6 removes the createMultipartUpload, signPart and getUploadParameters options that lib/uppy/s3-multipart.js and uppy-upload.js use, and @uppy/utils, which loader-shims.js gives to plugins, moves into @uppy/core; a person needs to port the S3 upload code

held.name: rack-protection
held.reason: 4.2.2 is the only release that fixes GHSA-pf75-2v58-7mxg and GHSA-vvhm-j6m8-64cw, and rack-protection 4 needs rack 3, which the Gemfile does not allow (rack < 3)

held.name: playwright
held.reason: Chrome for Testing 159, which playwright 1.65 installs, rejects origin "*" in the Storage.clearDataForOrigin call that clear_storage in spec/support/system/capybara_patches.rb sends, so every system test fails; a person needs to change clear_storage (found in #46817)

held.name: playwright-ruby-client
held.reason: Chrome for Testing 159, which playwright 1.65 installs, rejects origin "*" in the Storage.clearDataForOrigin call that clear_storage in spec/support/system/capybara_patches.rb sends, so every system test fails; a person needs to change clear_storage (found in #46817)
